hadiths.text: Faith has over seventy branches, the most excellent of which is the declaration that there is no god but Allah, and the humblest of which is the removal of harmful things from the path, and modesty is a branch of faith.
benefits: Provides understanding of the comprehensiveness of faith
Teaches respect for moral values by making modesty (Haya) a part of faith

hadiths.text: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
benefits: Complete faith requires desiring good for others
Teaches unity and love in Muslim society

hadiths.text: The keys to Paradise are the testimony that there is no god but Allah.
benefits: Declaration of Tawheed is the means to attain Paradise
Highlights the greatness and virtue of Kalimah Tayyibah
Shows the path to success after death

hadiths.text: The best of deeds is faith in Allah and striving in His cause.
benefits: Declares faith and jihad as the best actions
Encourages struggle for the supremacy of religion
Explained as a means of success in this world and the Hereafter
Shows the practical form of faith is jihad
